newsitem.title: USA: Heinz president raises stake in company.
newsitem.headline: Heinz president raises stake in company.

text.p: H.J. Heinz Co said on Wednesday that its president and chief operating officer William Johnson had increased his ownership in the company by more than 82 percent to a total of 183,398 shares.
At yesterday's closing stock price, Johnson's stake in Heinz now stands at about $8.4 million, Heinz said. Johnson increased his stake by 82,666 shares, or roughly $3.8 million.
Johnson increased his holdings by exercising options for 323,000 shares at an average exercise price of $23.13 per share, the company said in a statement.
Johnson holds options to purchase an additional 1,362,500 Heinz shares under the company's stock option plans, the company added.
